recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-17266 unless a future Vocabulary/FHIR-I decision changes the policy for value-set-specific displays in expansions or CodeableConcept.text.
issue_request: FHIR-17266 was a Published STU3 FHIR-core ValueSet change request from Vocabulary, resolved Persuasive. It asked to add an example showing how ValueSet.compose.include.concept.display is used, based on a terminology Zulip discussion about whether a value-set-specific display such as "Step Count" belongs in CodeableConcept.text rather than Coding.display.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites GH#7a32b4a312. Commit 7a32b4a31253f8389987096e0a5c1931efffaea7 added an example block to source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml showing a ValueSet with LOINC 55423-8 and value-set display "Step Count", the matching expansion display, and the resulting Observation.code where Coding.display uses the LOINC display while CodeableConcept.text carries "Step Count".
additional_context: ValueSet is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The linked Zulip thread records the original implementer confusion and confirms the requested semantics. Related Published issue FHIR-18151 clarified the same ValueSet display guidance and is already represented on the combined branch. Later Published issue FHIR-37603 further clarified datatypes.html by explicitly excluding value-set-defined displays/designations from Coding.display.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source still contains the FHIR-17266 Step Count example in the active ValueSet narrative, and the surrounding ValueSet and datatype guidance still supports the same rule, so no source edit is needed.

related_jiras.note: Published ValueSet issue clarified the surrounding ValueSet.compose.include.concept.display notes and is already represented on the combined branch by c07ec125cae463c72cdbbe9f8bb39eb4071e0537.
Published datatype clarification preserved the FHIR-17266 distinction by excluding ValueSet.include.concept.display and ValueSet.include.concept.designation.value from Coding.display.

Published ValueSet designation issue documented the relationship between display, designations, and Resource.language; it helps explain nearby display/designation text but is not the requested example.
